slides.title: The big idea
slides.html:
Point-slope form: y − y1 = m(x − x1). Slope-intercept form: y = mx + b.

Example: find the line through (4, 1) parallel to y = 3x − 1. A parallel line has the same slope, 3, so y − 1 = 3(x − 4), which simplifies to y = 3x − 11. The line through (4, 1) perpendicular to it has slope −1/3: y − 1 = −(1/3)(x − 4), so y = −(1/3)x + 7/3. Check by substituting the point: −4/3 + 7/3 = 1.
